title: Trainings | Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention | CDC
content: March 28, 2024 Trainings At a glance The Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program provides training for healthcare and public health professionals. Healthcare and public health professionals: access training to help prevent childhood lead poisoning in your community. Background Lead is a naturally occurring metal that can cause health problems in children younger than 6 years of age. At high levels, lead poisoning can be fatal. No safe blood lead level has been identified. Knowledge and awareness about lead as a public health concern is essential to prevention. Available Training Training: Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Training on the hazards of lead as well as information on lead program implementation.
